ValidationRule.description: Parent Account is required if the ETM Category value is either Subsidiary or Independent Subsidiary.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Parent_Account__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(ETM_Category__c, "Subsidiary"), ISPICKVAL(ETM_Category__c, "Independent Subsidiary")), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Parent Account must be populated if the ETM Category is either "Subsidiary" or "Independent Subsidiary".
